On December 12, 2022, BGLD on BNB Chain suffered an $18,000 exploit via spot price manipulation, allowing the attacker to manipulate AMM reserves and extract value. The incident was facilitated by dependence on a manipulable spot price source for critical operations. The protocol relied on the spot price from AMM reserves for collateral or settlement decisions. The attacker manipulated token reserves in liquidity pools to distort the price, extracting value by exploiting the resulting price discrepancy.
